source: CEO spec §2 (visual communication / content / marketing), PDF #10 §7 (brand voice configurable per organization)
positioning: Nibrexo builds AI-assisted operating systems for digital business operations, with a specialist focus on dental and clinical-adjacent workflows.
tone: Direct, precise and evidence-led. Professional without jargon. No hype, no invented proof.
do: State what is known, what is assumed and what is unknown.
Prefer concrete deliverables over abstract advice.

channels.instagram: Visual-first, short caption, clear call to action.
channels.tiktok: Hook in the first two seconds, practical payoff.
channels.email: One purpose per email, explicit next step.
